note: Ventura County beach campground on a low bench between US-101 and the Pacific NW of Ventura, the outer row of back-in sites along a rock breakwater above the surf. Sites 25-42 have no campfires. The county closes the park during king tides and coastal flooding. --Claude
summary: Faria Beach Park (Ventura County): plain sites $39-51 by season (full hookups +$20, sites 14-24 and 39-42), $10 online booking fee, 180-day window, 7-night peak limit; showers, Wi-Fi, concession. Bayfront confirmed. Website -> the park's own county page. Temporarily closed through Nov 27 for king tides.
flags: STATUS: the park page has a closure notice. Faria and Hobson are 'temporarily closed' for king-tide coastal flooding, and reservations through Fri Nov 27 are refunded. It is a short closure ending tomorrow, so status is left open. The county repeats this closure whenever the tides are high.

WATERFRONT bayfront kept. On Esri imagery, the outer row of pads runs along a rock revetment 10-30 m above the surf, from about 34.3181,-119.3905 to 34.3172,-119.3888, with US-101 behind the camp, not between it and the shore. rvlove (2024): 'Many sites have only a rocky breakwater between their RV and the crashing waves.' A travel guide quoted by search gives 'Numbers 7 - 34 are directly on the ocean'; that is third-party and unverified, since the county's itinio site map sat behind a human-verification wall. There is no sand beach at the sites; reviewers describe a stairway down from the bench.
PIN 34.3185,-119.3905 OK: it sits at the campground loop, under 60 m from the centre of the pads.

Booking engine ventura.itinio.com was not read (human-verification wall), so there is no per-site length, availability or fcfs data. The fee schedule says 'At beach parks, an individual may reserve only one site at a time per reservation period.'
Rate gate: the plain-site high is $51, and full-hookup sites run $67-74. A county park is not subject to the private-park price gate; noted only.
